label: Children's storybook
summary: Soft gouache colours, gentle outlines, paper grain — procedurally drawn characters
history: Inspired by gouache-painted children's picture books: soft colour, rounded friendly shapes and visible paper.
look: Procedurally drawn characters and places with soft gouache colours, gentle brown outlines that follow each fill, round faces with rosy cheeks and a warm paper grain over everything.

line.colour: Auto — a darker shade of each fill, never pure black
line.quality: Slight hand wobble, smooth rounded curves

fill: Flat gouache fills, slightly desaturated and pulled towards cream
shading: Soft gradient shading on the shadow side
texture: Paper grain over the whole frame

characters.proportions: Large heads (≈1.14×), short bodies, rounded limbs
characters.faces: Storybook eyes with a highlight, rosy blush, small smile
characters.poses: Gentle, readable poses: wave, point, walk, sit, hug
characters.costume: Simple clothes with one or two colours, no logos

environment.sky: Pale cream-blue gradient with soft clouds

border: Soft rounded frame in the banner border colour

composition.focalPoint: Character in the lower-middle third, title at the top
composition.framing: Medium-wide shots so faces and setting are both visible
composition.negativeSpace: Generous sky space for the title
composition.depth: Three parallax layers: sky, hills, foreground props

libraryPictureLook.spriteFilter: saturate(0.9) sepia(0.12) drop-shadow(2px 0 0 #6B4A35) drop-shadow(-2px 0 0 #6B4A35) drop-shadow(0 2px 0 #6B4A35) drop-shadow(0 -2px 0 #6B4A35)

dos: Keep the same cast in every scene
Use warm light and rounded shapes
Give titles a cream glow so they read over busy art
donts: Fast whip pans or glitch effects

generation.description: Soft, colorful, friendly storybook illustrations designed for children's storytelling.
generation.visualIdentity: Warm, magical, welcoming and imaginative picture-book illustration.
generation.linework: Soft, rounded and slightly organic outlines.
generation.textures: Watercolor washes, subtle paper grain, soft digital brush strokes.
generation.characters: Cute expressive characters with rounded faces, large friendly eyes, simplified anatomy and approachable proportions.
generation.backgrounds: Colorful villages, forests, gardens, magical castles, cozy houses and imaginative landscapes.
generation.lighting: Soft daylight, warm sunlight, gentle ambient lighting and magical glows.
generation.composition: Clear foreground characters, readable environments, balanced negative space and simple visual storytelling.

Use approachable proportions, cheerful expressions and a magical storybook atmosphere.
